const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
manifest_path=Path('.ai/task/repair-w64-20261003/PACK-MANIFEST.json')
data=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
outroot=Path('evidence/quality/repair-window-64-20261003/orchestration')
errors=[]
seen=set()
for i,x in enumerate(data['files'],1):
    src=Path(x['source'])
    rel=Path(x['relative_destination'])
    if src.is_absolute() or rel.is_absolute() or '..' in src.parts or '..' in rel.parts:
        errors.append(f'{i}: unsafe path')
        continue
    if x['relative_destination'] in seen:
        errors.append(f'{i}: duplicate destination {rel}')
    seen.add(x['relative_destination'])
    if not src.is_file():
        errors.append(f'{i}: missing source {src}')
        continue
    b=src.read_bytes(); sha=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
    if sha != x['sha256'] or len(b) != x['bytes']:
        errors.append(f'{i}: source mismatch {src}: {sha}/{len(b)} expected {x["sha256"]}/{x["bytes"]}')
    dst=outroot/rel
    if dst.exists() and dst.read_bytes()!=b:
        errors.append(f'{i}: existing destination differs {dst}')
print(f'pack_source_entries={len(data["files"])} unique_destinations={len(seen)}')
print(f'pack_declared_bytes={data["total_bytes"]} actual_bytes={sum(Path(x["source"]).stat().st_size for x in data["files"])}')
print(f'existing_pack_targets={sum((outroot/Path(x["relative_destination"])).exists() for x in data["files"])}')
print(f'preflight_errors={len(errors)}')
for e in errors: print(e)
if errors: sys.exit(1)

candidate=Path('.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window64-20261003-candidate-catalog')
files=sorted(p.relative_to(candidate).as_posix() for p in candidate.rglob('*') if p.is_file())
expected=[
'evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog/entries.jsonl',
'evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog/exclusions.jsonl',
'evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog/manifest.json',
'i18n/quality/production-review-v2-lite/catalog-v1.schema.json',
'i18n/quality/production-review-v2-lite/policy-v1.json']
print('candidate_files_exact=', files==expected)
if files!=expected:
    print(files); sys.exit(1)

pub_task=['PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md','CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json','MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json','TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json','SCOPE.json','SOURCE-CLAIMS.json','NEW-TARGETS.json','HOST-NOTE-r0a1-archive-order.md']

missing=[str(p) for p in [*(Path('.ai/task/repair-w64-20261003')/x for x in pub_task),*(Path(x) for x in pub_art+pub_chain)] if not p.is_file()]
print(f'publication_task_files={len(pub_task)} missing={len(missing)}')
if missing:
    print(*missing,sep='\n'); sys.exit(1)
for p in [Path('evidence/quality/repair-window-64-20261003/IMPLEMENTATION.md'),Path('evidence/quality/repair-window-64-20261003/VALIDATION.json')]:
    print(f'preserve {p} {hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}')
